gloss: LP record; vinyl album; long-playing record

definitions.explanation: A 33⅓ rpm vinyl record, typically 12 inches in diameter, holding around 20 minutes of music per side. Abbreviation of English "long-playing".

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧LP⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。

LP⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧CD⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people feel that LP records have a warmer sound than CDs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、LP⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦レコード→レコード：02990_rekoodo⟧プレーヤー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, even among the younger generation, more and more people are buying record players to listen to LPs.

notes:
Borrowed directly from English "LP" (long-playing). The Roman letters are read individually: え + る + ぴー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- LP⟦レコード→レコード：02990_rekoodo⟧: LP record (often written in full)
- LP⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧: to listen to an LP
- LP⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect LPs
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧LP: used/secondhand LPs
- LP⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧: LP album cover/sleeve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レコード→レコード：02990_rekoodo⟧: record — the general term for vinyl records
- ⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧: album — refers to a music release in any format
- ⟦シングル→シングル：10949_shinguru⟧: single — short record, originally a 7-inch 45 rpm disc
- EP: EP — extended play, between a single and an LP in length
